description: Modbus RTU gateway for Panasonic and Sanyo air conditioners: on/off, mode, fan speed, vanes, setpoint, temperatures, alarms, error codes and gateway settings
source: HMS Networks / Intesis, INMBSPAN001R000 user manual

sources.title: INMBSPAN001R000 – Modbus RTU interface – User manual

notes: Modbus RTU over EIA-485. Function 03 or 04 reads, 06 or 16 writes. The baud rate and slave address are set with the DIP switches (factory: 9600 baud, 8N1).
Addresses are the protocol addresses of the manual (the PLC addresses less 1).
Temperatures are in °C or °F and in degrees or tenths of a degree, as set with the DIP switches; their entries say so.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: AC unit Temperature Setpoint
registers.description: -32768 (Initialization value) 16..32ºC (ºC/x10ºC) 61..90ºF Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Temperature reference
registers.description: -32768: Initialization value. Value invalid, which comes from the IU’s sensor. If the value that is shown in register 22 (23 PLC) is valid, the address is going to take this value. Ranges are specific from Manufacturer (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC unit Operation Time
registers.description: 0..65535 (hours). Counts the time the AC unit is in “On” state.

registers.name: Error Code
registers.description: 0: No Error active 65535 (-1): Error in the communication of Gateway with the AC unit Any other error present, see the table at the end of this document.

registers.name: Indoor unit´s ambient temperature from external sensor (at Modbus side)
registers.description: -32768: Initialization value. No temperature is being provided from an input sensor. There’s no input sensor. Other: (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.

registers.name: AC setpoint temperature
registers.description: When no external temperature is provided, this read-only register will have the same value as register 5 (PLC addressing). In all cases, it will show the current setpoint in the indoor unit. Ranges specific from Manufacturer (ºC/x10ºC/ºF) Degrees or tenths of a degree, °C or °F, as set with the DIP switches; -32768 means not initialised.
